title: Meteorec IREICA1: daily measurements of the weather station Rečica ob Savinji (Slovenia), 2019–
description:
Daily outdoor measurements of the amateur weather station IREICA1 in Rečica ob Savinji (Upper Savinja Valley, Slovenia; 46.325779° N, 14.921137° E, 366 m a.s.l.), measured since 7 November 2019. Columns: date (local day, Europe/Ljubljana), temp_max_c, temp_min_c, temp_avg_c (°C), precip_mm (mm, daily total), wind_max_kmh, wind_avg_kmh (km/h), humidity_avg_pct (%). Empty cell = no value. Days without measurements are missing (a few gaps), and days that history.json fills from the ERA5 reanalysis are excluded: every row is a station measurement. Only outdoor sensors are included.

Dnevne zunanje meritve vremenske postaje IREICA1 v Rečici ob Savinji (Zgornja Savinjska dolina) od 7. 11. 2019: temperatura, padavine, veter, vlaga. Vsaka vrstica je meritev postaje; dnevi iz reanalize ERA5 so izpuščeni. Posodobljeno dnevno na meteorec.si/podatki; ta zapis je posnetek na datum izdaje.

Station data are amateur-grade (Ecowitt sensors, no formal calibration or siting audit); see the page for known caveats.
notes: Source of truth is https://meteorec.si/history.json; this CSV is generated by tools/export_dataset.py in https://github.com/ibanezar/weather-station. Cite the DOI of the version you used.
